$comment: Scraper URL + selector + feed config. Edit here, never hardcode in *.ts. Selectors are intentionally externalised so HTML structure changes only require editing this file, not redeploying TypeScript changes.

strata.$comment: Strata is paid commercial intelligence. URL, selectors, and feed shape are placeholders until production credentials are provisioned. The scraper reads STRATA_BASE_URL / STRATA_USERNAME / STRATA_PASSWORD from env; if any are missing it logs and skips cleanly without writing to scraper_errors.

news.$comment: List RSS/Atom feed URLs here. Default empty so production deploy must opt-in; production sets feeds via NEWS_FEEDS env var or by editing this file. Feed entries with a pubDate older than `maxAgeDays` are ignored.
